document.cue: Describe an older person you admire.

text: The person I'd like to talk about is Raisa Ivanovna, an eighty-year-old woman who lives on the floor below us. She used to be a paediatrician, and I've known her since I was a small child, because she often looked after me when my parents were at work.

Physically she's tiny, but she has an enormous amount of energy. She walks to the market every morning, does crosswords in three languages and still reads the news every day so that she can argue about it with my father. She's also very direct — if she thinks you're making a mistake, she'll tell you, but always kindly.

A couple of years ago she decided she wanted to video-call her grandson in Germany, so she asked me to teach her how to use a smartphone. Within a month she was sending me voice messages and funny stickers, and now she's the one showing her friends how to do it.

What I admire most is her attitude to life. She's had some really difficult times — she lost her husband quite young and raised two children on her own — but she never complains and she's always curious about new things. She proves that getting older doesn't have to mean slowing down.
Whenever I feel sorry for myself, I think of her climbing the stairs with her shopping bags, and it gives me a bit of perspective.

tips.en: Physically tiny but full of energy — a vivid portrait in one sentence.
tips.kk: Physically tiny, but enormous energy — бір сөйлемдегі жарқын портрет.
tips.ru: Physically tiny, but enormous energy — яркий портрет в одной фразе.
tips.example: Physically she's tiny, but she has an enormous amount of energy

tips.en: Now she's the one showing her friends — the learner became the teacher.
tips.kk: Now she's the one showing her friends — оқушы ұстазға айналды.
tips.ru: Now she's the one showing her friends — ученица стала учителем.
tips.example: now she's the one showing her friends how to do it

note.en: “Is not necessarily the end of an active life”.

phrases.text: doesn't have to mean slowing down

note.en: Who she is and how they know each other — straight away, with a childhood detail.
note.kk: Кім және қайдан таныс — бірден, балалық шақтан дерекпен.
note.ru: Кто и откуда знакомы — сразу, с деталью из детства.

note.en: What she is like — a contrast between her size and energy, with specific habits.
note.kk: Ол қандай — сырт келбеті мен қуатының қарама-қайшылығы, нақты әдеттері.
note.ru: Какая она — контраст внешности и энергии, конкретные привычки.

note.en: The smartphone story shows her character better than adjectives.
note.kk: Смартфон туралы оқиға мінезді сын есімнен жақсы көрсетеді.
note.ru: История со смартфоном показывает характер лучше прилагательных.

note.en: Why I admire her — a hard life and optimism.
note.kk: Неге тамсанамын — қиын өмір және оптимизм.
note.ru: Почему восхищаюсь — трудная жизнь и оптимизм.

note.en: The ending shows how her example affects the speaker.
note.kk: Аяқталуы — оның үлгісі сөйлеушіге қалай әсер етеді.
note.ru: Концовка — как её пример влияет на говорящего.
